latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Daily News skill.

- Generates a daily AI news brief summarizing the top domestic and international AI stories from the past 24 hours.
- Each news item includes a title, reason for recommendation, recommendation score, summary, and original link.
- Automatically collects news every morning at 7:30 AM or on user request.
- Prioritizes authoritative sources and impactful, industry-relevant news.
- Supports both Chinese and English AI news coverage.
- Outlines workflow for searching, filtering, fetching, and compiling news summaries.
